newsitem.title: USA: Bausch & Lomb buys S. Africa distributor.
newsitem.headline: Bausch & Lomb buys S. Africa distributor.

text.p: Bausch & Lomb said on Tuesday it has acquired the operations of its exclusive distributor in South Africa, SA Vision Care Pty. Ltd.

The acquisition comes eight years after the global eye-care company divested its South African subsidiary because of concerns about the political and economic environment in the country, the company said. The subsidiary will be called Bausch & Lomb (South Africa) (Proprietary) Ltd.
Details of the purchase agreement were not disclosed. However, Bausch & Lomb said the purchase will not impact earnings for 1996.
